context: Tests whether the agent produces a correctly structured, publishable Docusaurus rehype plugin. The plugin must use hastscript for HAST node creation, traverse element nodes by tagName, handle external links with security attributes, merge class arrays rather than overwriting them, and ship with proper TypeScript definitions and a well-formed package.json.

checklist.name: hastscript import
checklist.description: index.js imports the `h` function from `hastscript` (e.g. `const { h } = require('hastscript')` or `import { h } from 'hastscript'`)

checklist.name: h() used for wrapper node
checklist.description: index.js uses `h(...)` from hastscript to construct the wrapper div node rather than manually building a plain object literal with `type`, `tagName`, and `children` fields

checklist.name: element traversal
checklist.description: index.js calls `visit(tree, 'element', ...)` (or equivalent) to traverse HAST element nodes — not raw text or generic node traversal

checklist.name: tagName-based dispatch
checklist.description: index.js checks `node.tagName` to distinguish between `pre`/`code`, `img`, and `a` element types

checklist.name: rel noopener noreferrer
checklist.description: index.js sets `node.properties.rel` to `'noopener noreferrer'` (or equivalent array/string) on external anchor elements

checklist.name: target _blank
checklist.description: index.js sets `node.properties.target` to `'_blank'` on external anchor elements

checklist.name: className array merge
checklist.description: index.js merges into the existing className array (e.g. spreads `...(node.properties.className || [])`) rather than overwriting it with a new array or string

checklist.name: TypeScript definitions file
checklist.description: index.d.ts exists and declares a plugin options interface plus exports the plugin typed as a `unified` Plugin (e.g. `Plugin<[PluginOptions?], Root>`) using types from `unified` and `hast`

checklist.name: files field present
checklist.description: package.json contains a `files` array that limits published artifacts (e.g. includes `index.js` and `index.d.ts`)
